root_cause_analysis: Instagram Graph API media download failed (error subcode 2207052). Meta servers were unable to fetch the media file from the provided GitHub raw URI (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../slide_1_20260926_084346.png). GitHub raw URLs often lack appropriate HTTP headers (such as Content-Type or Content-Length) or enforce rate-limiting/redirects incompatible with Meta's media crawler requirements.
actionable_instructions: Migrate image hosting from raw.githubusercontent.com to a standard public storage bucket or CDN (e.g., AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, or Cloudinary).
Ensure image URIs are directly accessible via public GET requests and return explicit 'image/png' or 'image/jpeg' Content-Type headers.
Verify image URLs are publicly reachable without requiring authentication or encountering HTTP redirects.
